title: TCP Write
text: Send TCP/IP packets to remote host over TCP/IP network, 1 input, 1 output; {Network role} sets the block as server, {Remote address} sets the iP address of remote server to which TCP/IP packets are sent, {Remote port} sets the iP port of remote server to which TCP/IP packets are, {Local port} sets the iP port on sending host from which TCP/IP packets are and {Byte order}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: msg
ports.summary: Stream of TCP/IP packets sent to the remote host scalar

params.name: Network role
params.values: Set the block as server or client Client (default) | Server

params.name: Remote address
params.values: IP address of remote server to which TCP/IP packets are sent 127.0.0.1 (default) | dotted-quad expression

params.name: Remote port
params.values: IP port of remote server to which TCP/IP packets are sent 25000 (default) | integer from 1 to 65,535

params.name: Local port
params.values: IP port on sending host from which TCP/IP packets are sent -1 (default) | integer from 1 to 65535
